title: Arbitrary-axis vector rotation uses the opposite sign convention from quaternion rotation
trigger: Rotate a multi-selection about +Z with a positive angle.
impact: Child positions orbit opposite their orientation change, distorting authored assemblies.

title: Retrograde equatorial orbital elements mirror the epoch position
trigger: Round-trip r=(0,1,0), v=(1,0,0), mu=1 through ElementsFromState and PropagateToTime at dt=0.
impact: The propagated position starts on the opposite side of the primary.

title: TryNormalise returns success with a zero vector after magnitude overflow
trigger: Normalize a large finite vector such as (FLT_MAX,0,0).
impact: Callers accept a zero direction as a valid unit vector; camera basis fallback is bypassed.

title: Orbital APIs report success after overflowing finite element intermediates
trigger: Use very large finite semi-major axes such as 1e13 or FLT_MAX.
impact: Propagation can return Ok without advancing, and sampling can return full counts containing infinity.

title: Matrix inverse rejects valid small-scale matrices as singular
trigger: Invert Scale(1e-4,1e-4,1e-4).
impact: Identity is returned instead of the valid reciprocal transform.

title: Half-space test is not invariant to large finite plane scaling
trigger: Classify an inside point using plane coefficients scaled to FLT_MAX.
impact: Overflow and NaN reject a point that the scale-equivalent plane accepts.

title: Quaternion normalization produces an invalid zero quaternion after magnitude overflow
trigger: Normalize a finite quaternion containing FLT_MAX.
impact: Authored/deserialized orientation can violate the unit-quaternion invariant.

title: Configurable data root is ignored for registered shaders
trigger: Register/create a shader under a non-default or absolute data root.
impact: Shader compilation uses the wrong path and fails.

title: Registration APIs return references invalidated by later registrations
trigger: Retain a returned reference, then grow the owning vector with more registrations.
impact: Dangling-reference use and undefined behavior.

title: Replacing a resident texture destroys the good resource before validating replacement
trigger: Replace a resident texture when decoding or backend creation fails.
impact: The last good texture is lost and the hash becomes non-resident.

title: Windows drive-relative paths are misclassified as absolute
trigger: Resolve a path such as C:foo.jpg.
impact: Resolution depends on ambient per-drive working directory instead of dataRoot.

title: Fixed-step broadphase ignores body-local collider offsets
trigger: Use a rotated non-zero-offset collider whose body origin lies outside the target grid cell.
impact: Actual collider pairs can be omitted before narrowphase, causing tunnelling.

title: Sphere and box terrain paths simulate offset colliders at the body origin
trigger: Move a sphere/box with a non-zero local offset near terrain.
impact: Bodies can fall through, float, or receive phantom terrain support.

title: Object CCD uses unrotated local centers and sphere-sphere CCD omits offsets
trigger: Sweep rotated bodies with non-zero collider-local positions.
impact: CCD computes wrong or missing time of impact; fast displaced shapes tunnel.

title: Release/Profile sphere model matrices discard non-zero local offsets
trigger: Render an offset sphere in Debug and Profile/Release.
impact: Optimized rendering disagrees with Debug and with collision/query centers.

title: Box model matrices treat local offsets as world-space offsets
trigger: Render a rotated box with non-zero local position.
impact: Rendered box separates from its physical collider.

title: BoundingSphere default constructor leaves promised local origin uninitialized
trigger: Default-construct BoundingSphere or a descriptor containing its default shape.
impact: NaN/indeterminate offsets propagate from otherwise valid default descriptors.

title: Rebinding a warmed point joint preserves impulse from the old body pair
trigger: Warm a point joint, update only its bodies, then step.
impact: Old impulse kicks the new body pair spuriously.

title: Solver snapshot preflight accepts payloads restore cannot safely commit
trigger: Supply malformed vector sizes or over-capacity replay solver data.
impact: Restore can abort or silently install incoherent state after preflight said safe.

title: Shared swept-overlay capacity can abort on valid high-speed scenes
trigger: Exceed 4096 aggregate overlay cells with fast/large bodies in one fixed step.
impact: Steady gameplay can fatal and long trajectories can leave an uncovered suffix.

title: Spatial-grid XOR key aliases distinct cells
trigger: Use cells (-5,-1,5) and (-5,1,-5), which both produce key 264535005.
impact: Distinct cells can collide in key-based broadphase/debug tracking and corrupt occupancy identity.

title: Passive camera water clamp uses startup config after live height changes
trigger: Change live water height, then use a passive non-authored camera.
impact: Camera can be engulfed by raised water or remain clamped above lowered water.

title: Terrain factory returns success when GPU mesh or shader creation failed
trigger: Fail terrain shader compilation or DX12 mesh creation during scene load.
impact: Scene reports success with invisible terrain and silent retries.

title: SkyBox reset reports success after mesh or shader creation failure
trigger: Fail sky shader or one face-mesh creation.
impact: Resource initialization falsely succeeds, then rendering repeatedly lacks sky resources.

title: RAW height-map loader silently accepts oversized files
trigger: Load a RAW file containing more than mapSize squared bytes.
impact: Only the prefix is used, silently cropping or misinterpreting the asset.

title: Inactive legacy field update wipes active authored-system timers
trigger: Update a disabled legacy field while an authored TornadoSystem remains active.
impact: All body exposure/cooldown timers reset, changing ejection timing.

title: Runtime body-count changes erase tornado state for all surviving bodies
trigger: Append or delete a body while other bodies have tornado exposure/cooldown.
impact: Every surviving body's history is reset; deletion also lacks swap-last remapping.

title: Single-precision tornado clock stops advancing at 262144 seconds
trigger: Reach or restore elapsed time 262144 seconds and tick at 1/120 second.
impact: Spawn, TTL, strength, and drift lifecycle freeze permanently.

title: Direct and saved-state objects accept invalid physical dimensions and mass
trigger: Author non-positive/non-finite radius, extents, mass, inertia, or restitution in direct/state objects.
impact: Invalid shapes and nominally dynamic fixed bodies enter physics/rendering.

title: Style-only documents pass through full scene mutation pipeline
trigger: Put objects, simulation, runtime, or capture members in an imported .style.json.
impact: A presentation style can inject bodies and mutate simulation/runtime policy.

title: Signed integer and numeric-boolean readers narrow 64-bit JSON without bounds checks
trigger: Provide integers outside the target int range.
impact: Values wrap and may validate as different counts or booleans while parse reports success.

title: Several authored path/text fields silently truncate
trigger: Supply capture/log/filter text longer than its fixed buffer.
impact: Loaded value differs from authored data and can target an unintended path.

title: Render graph omits required UAV ordering barriers
trigger: A later pass accesses a prior UAV-written resource while state remains UnorderedAccess.
impact: Later GPU work may observe incomplete or stale writes.

title: Same-pass read/write declarations compile into impossible pre-callback state
trigger: Declare one subresource as both read and write in the same pass.
impact: Compiled transitions cannot satisfy both declarations during the callback.

title: Material-table texture failure is treated as successful primitive-batch readiness
trigger: Fail material-table texture creation.
impact: Draws continue with null binding and incorrect materials while retrying each batch.

title: Negative interpolation alpha clamps position but extrapolates orientation
trigger: Refresh with presentationAlpha below zero.
impact: Position stays at endpoint while orientation rotates away, producing inconsistent pose.

title: Malformed SDF advance metrics are trusted
trigger: Load a structurally valid font atlas with NaN, infinite, negative, or extreme advances.
impact: UI measurement and glyph geometry become broken or non-finite.

title: Extreme numeric material modes invoke out-of-range float-to-int conversion
trigger: Author a finite material mode such as 3.4e38.
impact: Undefined conversion behavior and incorrect material selection.

title: SDF generator reports success after failed GDI operations or short writes
trigger: Cause glyph measurement/draw or atlas-file write failure.
impact: Generator prints success and can leave a corrupt atlas.

title: Frame-graph diagnostic writer never retries identical frame after I/O failure
trigger: Fail first write, restore access, and keep graph unchanged.
impact: Diagnostic file remains missing/stale until graph shape changes.

title: Repeated window sizes exhaust retained graph-transient RTV pool
trigger: Resize cinematic rendering through more than the bounded distinct extents.
impact: VRAM and 32-row RTV heap grow until fatal exhaustion.

title: DXR constants and TLAS instance descriptors race in-flight GPU reads
trigger: Submit consecutive DXR frames while the GPU is backlogged.
impact: Previous frame can read next/torn camera and transform data.

title: Oversized geometry attributes cause out-of-bounds reads and stack writes
trigger: Create geometry with 13+ dynamic or more than 8 instanced attributes.
impact: Fixed arrays are over-read and pipeline stack layout can be overwritten.

title: DXR dispatch proceeds with unbound or stale material descriptor table
trigger: Dispatch reflections with any invalid/missing texture handle.
impact: Stale sampling, validation errors, or device faults.

title: Same-compile transient aliasing can fatal on incompatible physical state
trigger: Alias non-overlapping logical textures whose initial/final access states differ.
impact: Execution fatals because compiled logical state disagrees with retained physical state.

title: DestroyDynamicVB never destroys or reclaims bounded handle
trigger: Perform 33 create/destroy cycles in one backend epoch.
impact: Process fatals despite no live buffers because dead records accumulate.

title: Instanced draws can exceed uploaded vertex or instance data
trigger: Pass counts larger than static/uploaded capacity or non-integral instance payload.
impact: GPU fetches beyond valid records produce garbage/zero geometry.

title: Batched NPOT mip generation drops edge texels
trigger: Generate mips for 10x10 or another chain with odd intermediate dimensions.
impact: Later mip levels omit last rows/columns, causing edge loss and filtering bias.

title: Separate skybox faces use wrap sampling and bleed opposite edges
trigger: View/sample a cube-face boundary with different opposite-edge colors.
impact: Visible seams in rasterized and raytraced sky/reflections.

title: Procedural sky is discontinuous at longitude wrap seam
trigger: Rotate camera across atan2 longitude seam with clouds/ridges enabled.
impact: Fixed vertical discontinuity appears in procedural sky features.

title: Trajectory ribbon does not clip segments at camera near plane
trigger: Move camera through a trajectory segment spanning behind/in front of eye.
impact: Ribbon width spikes, spans screen, or pops.

title: Canceling Replay Policy slider leaves uncommitted value displayed
trigger: Begin dragging retention/budget then lose focus, switch tabs, or minimize before release.
impact: UI indefinitely displays policy runtime never accepted.

title: Legal narrow clients make controls unreachable and violate clamp precondition
trigger: Resize client below 540 pixels, especially below 404 in minimized editor.
impact: Controls go offscreen; std::clamp receives lo>hi, invoking undefined behavior.

title: Programmatic scrolling after 1.2 seconds never reveals scrollbar
trigger: Call SetScrollY when runtime now is greater than 1.2.
impact: Scroll position changes without scrollbar feedback.

title: Position-only draw-cache replay is effectively dead during dragging
trigger: Drag across normal frames where time and mouse position change.
impact: Full UI command rebuild occurs every frame instead of retained replay.

title: Scene header overflows supported minimum width
trigger: Open Scene tab at 520-pixel minimum window width.
impact: Save Defaults extends beyond window and part cannot be hit.

title: Automated next-scene load failure becomes successful process exit
trigger: Complete one automated scene when the next queued scene is missing/corrupt.
impact: Incomplete suite/capture exits 0 and masks content/engine failure.

title: Recording save failure during orderly shutdown is not propagated
trigger: End normally with active recording while manifest publication fails.
impact: Requested reproduction artifact is absent/corrupt while process exits successfully.

title: Raw mouse registration failure is silently accepted
trigger: RegisterRawInputDevices returns FALSE.
impact: App starts but relative mouse-look receives no raw deltas or diagnostic.

title: Second recording in same directory overwrites older manifest sidecars
trigger: Save two differently named recordings in one directory.
impact: Older immutable recording becomes unreplayable because fixed scene/replay sidecars are replaced.

title: Output-path collisions can overwrite input interaction script
trigger: Use the same/canonical-equivalent path for script and trace or report.
impact: Playback invocation truncates and destroys its reproduction input.

title: Recorded sidecars are consumed before SHA-256 validation
trigger: Modify a digest-bound scene/replay sidecar before playback.
impact: Altered data is loaded before rejection, and malformed data can exit without the required automation report.

title: Malformed interaction JSON can throw instead of recoverable failure
trigger: Use non-object root or wrong-typed baseline replay/format fields.
impact: Uncaught nlohmann exception terminates process instead of producing diagnostic/report.

title: Final report short writes are reported as success
trigger: Let report destination open but fail during write or close.
impact: Process may exit 0 with missing/truncated invalid JSON report.

title: Replay artifact derivation can escape directory or collide with report
trigger: Use a dotted parent with extensionless report or a report ending .skreplay.
impact: Artifact is misplaced or overwritten while report claims it was saved.

title: Equal-frame legacy actions lose authored order
trigger: Load multiple order-dependent actions on one frame.
impact: Unstable sort can permute commands and change deterministic result.

title: Locked dolly accepts steps beyond orbit-distance limits
trigger: Move forward/backward by a step crossing minViewMag or maxViewMag.
impact: Camera penetrates/crosses target or exceeds maximum and retains invalid distance.

title: Simultaneous locked yaw and pitch drift fixed orbit target
trigger: Apply nonzero yaw and pitch together in locked mode.
impact: Independent deltas move eye off orbit sphere, then recovery moves the target.

title: Terrain correction during tween is discarded at completion
trigger: Tween to a destination below terrain, complete, then publish next frame.
impact: Completion frame is clamped but next frame snaps to the original below-terrain pose.

title: Buffered screenshot close failures are reported as success
trigger: Let fwrite buffer data but fclose/flush fail.
impact: Truncated image is logged as captured and automation may advance as if evidence exists.

title: One-shot capture suppresses same-frame interval capture
trigger: Schedule one-shot and interval capture for the same frame.
impact: Expected interval artifact and counter event are permanently skipped.

title: Mixed path separators derive wrong screenshot-and-exit output name
trigger: Use a scene path where a backslash occurs after any forward slash.
impact: Output is written to wrong relative path or fails unexpectedly.

title: Failed screenshot write destroys prior valid artifact
trigger: Overwrite an existing image and inject a short write.
impact: Good artifact is truncated and corrupt partial remains at final path.

title: Scene activation preserves transient diagnostics from previous scene
trigger: Load scene B after diagnostic activity in same-sized scene A.
impact: Scene-B frames falsely display prior-scene collision/contact/cell state.

title: Disabling broadphase overlay freezes stale cells indefinitely
trigger: Disable overlay, change scene/state, wait, then re-enable.
impact: Arbitrarily old cells render with restarted fade.

title: First collision-visualizer frame allocates inside guarded Render phase
trigger: Enable collision visualization for first time under gameplay allocation guard.
impact: Normal toggle causes allocation violations, failed strict run, and hitch.

title: Contact visualization grows uncapped linger cache during gameplay
trigger: Enable contacts with changing contact identities under allocation guard.
impact: Repeated steady-gameplay allocations violate policy and grow transient memory.

title: Physics debug line staging reallocates with six bodies
trigger: Render Axes mode for six or more bodies under allocation guard.
impact: Ordinary overlay exceeds reserve and allocates during Render phase.

title: Broadphase line staging covers only 200 of 2048 tracked cells
trigger: Render 201+ tracked cells under allocation guard.
impact: Supported workload reallocates during guarded Render phase.

title: Unopenable perf log still enables perf-test scene control
trigger: Configure perfLog to an unopenable path and complete target frames.
impact: No artifact is created, but scene reruns/advances and can exit successfully.

title: Scene memory totals omit most store allocations
trigger: Inspect memory diagnostics for any non-empty scene.
impact: Engine-owned memory is systematically underreported and hidden as unattributed process memory.

title: Perf CSV write and flush failures are silently successful
trigger: Cause post-open write, flush, or close failure.
impact: Run can exit successfully with missing/truncated performance evidence.

title: Main-memory dump reports success after partial write or close failure
trigger: Cause post-open dump write or close failure.
impact: Truncated invalid JSON is reported as successfully written.

title: C-key overlay cycle clears independent terrain/pipeline layers
trigger: Enable terrain/pipeline layer, then press C.
impact: Instead of preserving independent layer, the shortcut clears all debug layers.

title: Retry after recoverable Start failure succeeds without renderer binding
trigger: Retry Start after initial BindContext failure on same owner.
impact: Start reports success with null renderer; next visible frame fatals.

title: First-build panel visibility automation is overwritten by default layout
trigger: Apply SetPanelVisible before first dock layout is built.
impact: Acknowledged automation command is silently lost.

title: FocusPanel reports success when ImGui focused nothing
trigger: Focus a never-created/default-hidden panel.
impact: Automation focus counters report success while input remains on another window.

title: Shutdown/restart preserves stale commands and lifecycle state
trigger: Generate a command, Shutdown before consume, then Start and consume.
impact: Restarted editor can replay stale mutations and advertise old status.

title: Narrow resize produces impossible dock dimensions
trigger: Resize normal client below 540 pixels.
impact: Central viewport collapses and split fractions exceed valid range.

title: Closing Game Viewport does not stop per-frame GPU capture
trigger: Hide only Game Viewport while editor remains visible.
impact: Unused full-client capture continues and can still fail the frame/app.

title: Shot-list loader accepts non-finite numbers and degenerate camera poses
trigger: Load equal eye/view or values converting to float infinity.
impact: Director can publish wrong/non-finite camera matrices or freeze phases.

title: Director blends opposite up vectors through zero
trigger: Blend valid poses with up vectors (0,1,0) and (0,-1,0).
impact: Camera produces abrupt 180-degree roll at midpoint.

title: Timer transitions discard elapsed-time overshoot
trigger: Tick a timer phase with dt exceeding its remaining duration.
impact: Timeline timing becomes frame-cadence dependent and accumulates delay.

title: Transient phase-style load failure is permanently latched
trigger: Temporarily fail style load, then restore same file/path within phase.
impact: Intended style is never retried until phase/path changes.

title: Live-style and capture polling consume stamps before successful reads
trigger: Temporarily deny read, then restore without changing timestamp/size.
impact: Valid style or screenshot command is ignored forever until file changes.

title: Oversized live-style paths invoke secure-CRT failure
trigger: Use 260+ byte directory or over-cap joined capture path.
impact: Invalid-parameter handler can terminate process instead of returning false.

title: Look Lab validates receipt metadata after creating partial bundle
trigger: Save with invalid UTC offset, then retry corrected request with same timestamp/seed.
impact: Orphaned partial bundle blocks corrected retry.

title: Long loaded shot-list paths are truncated before Save
trigger: Load/edit/save through path longer than 259 bytes.
impact: Save targets truncated nonexistent or unintended path.

title: Look Lab timestamp accepts impossible calendar dates
trigger: Use dates such as 2026-02-31 or non-leap 2025-02-29.
impact: Bundles/receipts claim invalid dates despite validated timestamp contract.

title: Replay restore omits recorded camera up vector
trigger: Restore a replay camera sample with roll/up different from the live camera slot.
impact: Eye/view restore but prior live up vector remains, producing wrong rolled orientation.

title: Saving during pending publication erases visible child trajectories
trigger: Save while a committed child ordinal >=240 is still represented by a pending build bank.
impact: Serializer zeros a still-visible child trajectory, so restored prediction loses data.

title: Prediction archive can mix snapshot nodes with live future ragdoll visuals
trigger: Save while live future ragdoll visuals change around snapshot publication.
impact: Archive can contain incoherent node/visual generations and restore mismatched prediction presentation.

title: Physics commit gate misses engine.cfg and hull inputs
locations: tools/check_physics_commit_gate.py; AGENTS.md physics validation input rules
trigger: Change engine.cfg or a .hull asset without touching paths recognized by affects_physics.
impact: Required physics validation may not trigger, and stale/untracked inputs can invalidate gate evidence.
